note: The largest White Mountain National Forest campground, in thirteen loops at the foot of Mount Washington; the Peabody River and Culhane Brook run through it, and the River loop sits beside the Peabody. Pinkham Notch and Gorham trailheads are close by. The Senior/Access discount does not cover the electric charge. Two pets per site. --Claude
summary: rec.gov catalog read: 168 sites (not 177), 71 take 25 ft+ (46 reservable), 30/50-amp electric + water on ~51 sites, $30 / $44 electric confirmed, some FCFS confirmed (67 sites not reservable). flags: Waterfront: SUGGEST riverview -> not waterfront (stored value is not --AWH). The Peabody River beside the RIVE loop is a braided gravel-bed stream; on Esri imagery (44.3268,-71.2188) each channel is ~10-20 m of water inside a ~30 m bed, so by size it is a creek and 'riverview' is the wrong class. The RV pads (RIVE 137, 140, 142, 146, around 44.3262-44.3268,-71.2190; sold by the night on rec.gov, 30-45 ft) sit ~35-45 m from the gravel bed through continuous canopy, so no open view holds. Only tent-only sites 150-153 (around 44.3270-44.3276,-71.2185) sit at the bank edge. Creekside for 137/140/142 would need a site photo showing an easy walk down with nothing between, which the canopy hides; default down to not waterfront.
